data.name: Luci
data.gender_notes: Luci is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Luci is recorded in name-lists as “Light, Luminous”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Luci expresses “Light, Luminous”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luci total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
data.cultural_impact: Luci is used in Biblical naming tradition with the meaning “Light, Luminous”.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Light, Luminous” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Luci; such symbolism is interpretive.

biblical_reference.note: Lucia of Beirut, a woman who was a prophetess and a disciple of Paul (Acts 13:5). Another Lucia is mentioned in Acts 1:24 as one of the seven deacons appointed by the apostles.
